name: food-delivery-app
description: Modern multi-vendor food delivery platform with AI-powered recommendations, live tracking, and merchant/courier/admin portals.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @food/api" "npm run dev -w @food/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @food/database && npm run build -w @food/shared && npm run build -w @food/ai && npm run build -w @food/api && npm run build -w @food/web
